lines.en: Rotting flesh drags on the ground.

lines.zh: 我拖着一只不听话的脚，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I drag one disobedient foot and shuffle on.

lines.zh: 腐肉一块块掉在路上，我不管。
lines.en: Chunks of rot drop behind me, and I do not care.
Corpse flesh flutters in the breeze.

lines.zh: 我用剩下一只眼对着你。
lines.en: I fix my one remaining eye on you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脖子，不是眼睛。
lines.en: I am staring at your neck, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 你可能是我认识的那个人。
lines.en: You might be someone I once knew.

lines.zh: 我的脖子歪着，视线没歪。
lines.en: My neck is crooked; my gaze is not.

lines.zh: 你躲在车后面，露出一只靴。
lines.en: You hide behind the car with one boot showing.

lines.zh: 腐烂的身躯痛苦地呻吟着。
lines.en: The rotting body moans in pain.
The pain of the end never ends.

lines.zh: 你体内有我想吃的东西。
lines.en: What you have inside is mine.

lines.zh: 靠近我，让你的灵魂离开。
lines.en: Come closer, let your soul leave.
Dinner just walked over on its own.
I smell the oil in that can.
My claws will tear you apart.
I tap the wall with a bare finger bone.
My stump jams against your chest.
I push through against the door frame.

lines.zh: 我肩头一顶，把木板撞断。
lines.en: One shove of my shoulder snaps the plank.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀，撞歪了我的下巴。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocked my jaw crooked.

lines.zh: 肩膀先顶上去，脖子歪着。
lines.en: I lead with the shoulder, neck twisted.

lines.zh: 我们互相扶着，守这间屋。
lines.en: We hold each other up and hold this room.
You are rotting too; I can tell.

lines.zh: 一起走吧，反正都回不去了。
lines.en: Walk with me. Neither of us goes back.

lines.zh: 我们两个一起守在门后。
lines.en: The two of us keep watch behind the door.
Half a sack of rice under the cabinet.
There should be something to eat here.
The taste of food is good.
I will bite a piece of meat.

lines.zh: 这里没有食物，继续前进。
我找到了新的食物来源。
lines.en: I found a new food source.

lines.zh: 你身上的烟草味盖不住血。
lines.en: Tobacco on you does not cover the blood.
You will soon belong to me.

lines.zh: 你流血了，那就省得我撕。
lines.en: You are bleeding; saves me the tearing.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声在废墟里太响了。
lines.en: Your breathing is far too loud in these ruins.

lines.zh: 我闻到新鲜的血，刚流出来的。
lines.en: I smell fresh blood, just spilled.

lines.zh: 这具身体的第 18 号，记住我。
lines.en: Number eighteen of this body; remember me.

lines.zh: 你踩碎玻璃，我全听见了。
lines.en: You stepped on glass, and I heard it all.

lines.zh: 尸群里只有我朝你走来。
lines.en: Of the whole horde, only I walk to you.

lines.zh: 干枯的手指，已经指到你。
lines.en: My dried finger is already pointing at you.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底在碎玻璃上打滑。
lines.en: Your soles slip on the broken glass.
You back into the wall. Perfect.
I open my mouth and my jaw hangs to one side.

lines.zh: 我抬起干瘪的手，指向你。
lines.en: I raise my withered hand and point at you.

lines.zh: 我把你逼到围墙的拐角。
lines.en: I press you into the corner of the wall.
I do not run, and you can no longer run.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的最后一支箭。
lines.en: I watch the last arrow in your hand.

lines.zh: 你躲在木箱后，箱子挡不住我。
lines.en: You hide behind a crate, but a crate will not stop me.
My drool drips onto the rubble.

lines.zh: 等我走近，你连呼吸都听得见。
lines.en: Soon you will hear even my breathing.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，不给你喘息。
lines.en: Step by step, I give you no rest.

lines.zh: 我的一只手早就没了，照样咬。
lines.en: One arm is long gone, and I still bite.

lines.zh: 我指节露出来了，敲得响。
lines.en: My knuckles show. They knock loudly.

lines.zh: 我指骨露出来了，敲得响。
lines.en: My finger bones are bare and they click.

lines.zh: 我那只空袖子甩起来打你。
lines.en: My empty sleeve whips at you.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，咬下去！
lines.en: I seize your collar and bite down!

lines.zh: 干枯的手指抠进你的伤口。
lines.en: My withered fingers dig into your wound.

lines.zh: 你推我一把，我只退了半步。
lines.en: You shove me, and I only stagger half a step.

lines.zh: 我压在你身上，骨头硌得你疼。
lines.en: I pin you down, and my bones dig into you.
This bite will leave a mark.

lines.zh: 饥渴难耐，又是一顿美餐！
我从翻倒的卡车下面爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out from under the overturned truck.
The night wind dies and I stand up.

lines.zh: 瓦砾下面伸出一只手，是我的。
lines.en: A hand pushes out of the rubble, and it is mine.

lines.zh: 末世的尘土落定，我站起来。
lines.en: The wasteland dust settles, and I stand.

lines.zh: 我从倒塌的墙缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out through a gap in the fallen wall.

lines.zh: 废城的风吹过我，我醒了。
lines.en: The wind of the dead city blows over me, and I wake.
The flames burn my decayed flesh.
The explosion tears at my flesh.
The arrow pierces my decayed flesh.

lines.zh: 魔法的寒气冻结了我的腐肉。
lines.en: The magic's cold freezes my decayed flesh.
Starvation makes my flesh rot faster.

lines.zh: 闪电击中我的腐朽之躯。

lines.en: The void tears at my flesh.
